description: This PHP class defines an Admin Controller for managing Sale Coupon reports in an OpenCart project. It handles displaying the report interface, saving configuration settings, and fetching coupon report data, including pagination and filtering.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Admin controller class for sale coupon report in OpenCart, managing report display, settings, and data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads report page, initializes breadcrumbs, titles, and prepares view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves report configuration settings if user has permission, responding with JSON status.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the coupon report view with the report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the coupon report list view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches coupon report data with optional date filtering and pagination, returning a rendered view.
